_tbtModeNote: tbtMode warn: TBT median over maxTbtMs prints WARN (not a failure) unless > maxTbtMs * tbtHardFactor, which FAILs. Set "hard" to gate TBT strictly. scoreMode warn: score median below minScore by <= scoreHardMargin prints WARN, more FAILs ("hard" = strict). LCP/CLS/firstLoadJsKb are always hard gates.
